verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Vue language service or editor extension that provides autocompletion or inline type errors. The Tooling Guide appears only as a bare link title with no content. The defineProps type-inference docs cover a different story, TypeScript typing of props, not editor language-service integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate autocompletion and inline type errors in my editor via a language service integration
